item.title: Liberal PM Attacks Trump’s Greenland Push As He Cozies Up With America’s No. 1 Enemy On Foreign Trip
item.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney flatly rejected President Donald Trump's bid to bring Greenland under U.S. control, declaring that the Arctic territory's future should be decided by Greenland and Denmark.

item.title: Hunter Biden’s Ex Asks Judge to Jail Him Over Child Support Dispute
item.description: “Incarcerate him in the Independence County Detention Center as a civil penalty until he purges his contempt by complying with this court’s orders."

item.title: Newsom’s 9% Homeless ‘Win’ Is Built On Half-Baked Data
item.description: Democratic Gov. Gavin Newsom touted a 9% decline in homelessness during his final state address based on dubious data that omitted nearly half the state.

item.title: Charlie Kirk’s Murder Prompts New Hate Crime Bill
item.description: Republican California Assemblywoman Laurie Davies has introduced a bill to add political affiliation to the state's hate crime classifications, telling the Daily Caller News Foundation she aims to "lower the political temperature."

item.title: Online Fundraisers For ICE Agent Injured In Renee Good Shooting Top $1 Million
item.description: Online fundraisers for the United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agent who reportedly suffered internal bleeding during a fatal incident in Minneapolis topped $1 million as of Friday afternoon.

item.title: Mamdani’s Progressive Coalition Already Embroiled In Bitter Race War
item.description: Some progressives are not pleased with the level of diversity among New York City socialist Mayor Zohran Mamdani’s top aides, The New York Times (NYT) reported.

item.title: Reporter to Trump: ‘Why Would You Want Somebody Else’s Nobel Prize?
item.description: “She said, you know, you’ve had eight wars and nobody deserves this prize more than in history than you do.”

item.title: California Official Launches Video Game To Solve Homelessness
item.description: San Francisco Homelessness Oversight Commission member Sharky Laguana launched an interactive website on homelessness policy trade-offs.

item.title: ‘As A Muslima’: Rashida Tlaib Blows Gasket Over ‘Neo-Nazi’ DHS Post Of Man Riding Horse
item.description: Democratic Michigan Rep. Rashida Tlaib went on an emotional rant over the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) recruitment posts on social media during a Friday shadow hearing in Minnesota.

item.title: DOJ Reportedly Investigating Tim Walz, Jacob Frey For Obstructing Law Enforcement
item.description: The Department of Justice is reportedly investigating Democratic Gov. Tim Walz of Minnesota and Democratic Mayor Jacob Frey of Minneapolis for obstruction, a local news outlet reported.
